notes: Turns on Surefire reruns for every build of the project through .mvn/maven.config, which Maven reads before the command line. Derived from the Apicurio commit, which passes the same property on the CI command line (see reject-surefire-rerun-on-ci-command-line). Change: the flag "-Dsurefire.rerunFailingTestsCount=2" is moved into a new .mvn/maven.config file; no index line is given because the file is new and hand written.
